expectations.text: skeleton_mentioned: Menciona skeleton screens o shimmer como solución principal (no solo spinner mejorado)
expectations.evidence: Section 1 is titled '1. Skeleton Loading (Shimmer Effect) — Recomendado' and is the first and primary recommendation, implementing the `shimmer` package with a full custom skeleton list widget.

expectations.text: code_example: Incluye código Flutter concreto y funcional (no solo pseudocódigo)
expectations.evidence: Includes complete functional Dart code: a full `StatefulWidget` with `FutureBuilder`, a `_buildSkeletonItem()` using `Shimmer.fromColors`, a `ProductRepository` with `SharedPreferences` caching, and an `AnimatedProductCard` with `AnimationController`.

expectations.text: explains_why: Explica por qué skeleton es mejor UX que CircularProgressIndicator
expectations.evidence: The problem section lists reasons why CircularProgressIndicator is bad ('el usuario no sabe cuánto tiempo faltará', 'pantalla vacía y rota'), but the skeleton section only says 'El usuario entiende de inmediato la estructura de lo que va a aparecer' without a direct, substantive explanation of why skeleton is psychologically or perceptually superior.

expectations.text: riverpod_when_method: Menciona .when() de AsyncValue o manejo de estados loading/error/data con Riverpod
expectations.evidence: Section 5 'Usando Riverpod o BLoC' shows `productsAsync.when(loading: () => _buildSkeletonList(), error: (error, stack) => _buildErrorWidget(error), data: (products) => _buildProductList(products))` using `FutureProvider`.

expectations.text: caching_mentioned: Menciona caché local (keepAlive, Hive, SharedPrefs, o stale-while-revalidate)
expectations.evidence: Section 3 'Caché Local con shared_preferences o hive' implements a full `ProductRepository` with `SharedPreferences`, cache duration validation, and a stale-while-revalidate pattern labeled explicitly as such.
